Matching replay creates neither duplicate lifecycle identities nor duplicate transitions; mismatched bindings and reused operation keys fail closed.
Real Restate 1.7.5 discovered the service, completed node A, survived a forced bridge kill during durable sleep, reconciled effects, and completed node B.

body.summary: Closed the worker lifecycle bindings end to end. Added a durable native lifecycle registry and CLI, wired Restate through stable WorkerRun and ProtocolMachine identities, gated resume on EffectKernel reconciliation, proved forced crash/restart recovery against a real Restate server, updated blocker accounting, and registered the measured architecture. The bounded proof digest is 2506a25cb387f1c64c17d40e7428697c897b164754c068dbf96647794123c5c0.
